summary: Add a documentation-only sign-in journey and limited, revocable documentation sessions without creating a Cloud tenant.
userImpact: Documentation readers can use their existing EnterpriseGlue accounts without creating a workspace.
configuration: Set EG_DOCUMENTATION_ORIGIN and an API-only EG_DOCUMENTATION_GATEWAY_SECRET matching the documentation gateway; unset configuration disables the integration.

changes: Add public documentation-origin configuration plus dedicated documentation grant, exchange, session-verification and sign-out endpoints.

notes: A bounded pending handoff identifier and at most four active documentation-token identifiers are stored in existing refresh-session metadata; no tenant rows or provisioning events are written.

security: Short-lived PKCE-bound single-use grants and audience-separated documentation tokens retain live account and source-session revocation checks. Recovery credentials cannot create documentation grants.
knownLimitations: Gateway routing and secrets must be deployed together before enabling the public documentation hostname.
The new flow is disabled without explicit gateway configuration. The gateway and hostname have not been deployed; real-provider/staging acceptance remains required.
rollback: Disable the documentation origin and gateway deployment. Existing account and organization flows remain independently available.
validation: 248 focused authentication/authorization tests, 111 account-session regressions, 13 account UI tests and 658 identity-local tests pass.
Typechecks, production frontend build, lint, route/OpenAPI inventory, contract parity and authorization structure/coverage checks pass.
Disposable PostgreSQL qualifies atomic handoff consumption and the exact gateway source over real HTTP, including independent documentation sign-out and parent-session revocation.
The packaged frontend documentation account journey passes Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with controlled account API responses. Real-provider signup and deployed staging acceptance remain pending.
